title: War in Ukraine: Zelensky visits Madrid for talks with PM Sanchez
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky will visit Madrid on Wednesday for talks with Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez, sources in the PM's office said. His visits to Spain are part of his efforts to rally diplomatic and military support from Western allies since the full-scale war broke out in 2022. FRANCE 24's Sarah Morris reports from Madrid.
